transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what finally got me here is that I'm just having a really hard time keeping my focus at work. I'm an electrician, so I have to do a lot of estimates and fill out code forms, but lately I just can't stick with one thing. Like, if I hear a tool noise, or my phone buzzes with a text, or even if I just get a new idea about organizing the workshop... I just get completely pulled off track. It's starting to cause problems because jobs are getting mixed up, and I really can't afford for that to happen.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention or focus when you were a child or in school?

No, not really. I mean, school was fine for me. I never had trouble paying attention when I was a kid or... or even later on during my apprenticeship. I could sit down and get my work done just fine back then. 

This whole thing where I can't keep my mind on one task, it's pretty new. I definitely didn't have this problem growing up.
Have you been feeling unusually energized or 'revved up' lately?

Yeah, definitely. I guess 'revved up' is a good way to put it. I’ve just been going nonstop lately. I'm bouncing from job sites to doing bids, and then I'm right back to rewiring test panels in the workshop. I keep starting all these new home-automation ideas before the last one is even finished. It just... it feels like sitting still is a complete waste of time right now.
Have you ever had periods in your life when you felt the opposite—down, depressed, or lacking energy for weeks at a time?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I'm just tired from a long shift or whatever, but nothing like what you're describing. I've never been stuck in bed for weeks or felt totally down like that. I usually have a pretty normal amount of energy, up until this recent thing where I just can't stop moving.
How long have you been feeling this revved up and constantly on the go?
It's been building up for a while now... I'd say about seven months. It started right around the time we took on the mortgage for the new workshop and all the upgraded equipment.
Despite these mix-ups, have you still been able to keep working, or has this completely disrupted your ability to do your job?

I'm still working, but... it's definitely causing problems. Clients have actually started complaining about missed details on jobs, and I've been mixing up the scheduling. Even my apprentices, they just... they don't really trust my direction the way they used to. 

And it's not just at the shop. At home, it's getting bad. The mortgage and the business are turning into these constant arguments. My wife feels like I'm putting everything we built at risk. So, yeah, I'm still going, but it's definitely disrupting things.
During these past few months, how has your sleep been? Have you felt like you need much less sleep than usual to feel rested?

Yeah, it's definitely been a lot less. For months now, I've been sleeping maybe... three or four hours a night. But I don't feel tired at all. I just pop up before dawn, feeling completely ready to go. I'll get right to pricing materials, answering emails, or sketching out another system, just feeling like I had a full night's rest.
Before these past seven months, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt this unusually energetic, active, or revved up?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had busy times at work before, but nothing like this where it just keeps going for months on end. This is the first time I've felt this... dialed in and energetic for this long.
